fields.description: Issue features editorials and local political coverage focused on Miami and Miami Beach, including debate over consolidation of city and county tax assessor functions, water-rate increases, and use of recall procedures. Prominent commentary addresses gambling and racetracks, alleged official tolerance of illegal gambling, and a reported police killing in Miami’s Black community. National policy discussion includes Secretary of Labor Maurice J. Tobin’s proposed $100-per-month pension plan. Additional items include a civil-rights dispute involving Miami Beach vagrancy arrests and a claim that federal funds for Seminoles are mismanaged, alongside regular columns and extensive local entertainment and business advertising.
